recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, minimalist studio portrait featuring a female subject kneeling on a white quilted surface. The composition is defined by a strong diagonal line created by the sofa back, contrasting against a dark, textured background. The lighting is soft and directional, emphasizing the textures of a light-colored knit top and metallic shorts.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's warm skin tones against the cool, dark background
The diagonal line of the white sofa bisecting the frame
Textural contrast between soft knitwear and reflective metallic fabric
Minimalist typography positioned in the upper-left negative space
coreInvariants: Deep shadow/dark background in the upper third
Subject centered but leaning into the diagonal

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, kneeling, occupying the middle and lower-right quadrants of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the sharp diagonal line of the white sofa back.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the typography in the top left, follows the diagonal sofa line down to the subject's pose, and returns to the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space in the upper-left and upper-right corners.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the foreground and background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text is all lowercase, thin weight, wide tracking
Secondary text is a thin, handwritten-style script
A single vertical hairline separator divides the two styles

composition.position: to the right of vertical bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid geometric sans and a fluid, personal script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, monolinear lowercase aesthetic.
Provides the clean, circular counters seen in the primary text.
Approximates the thin, informal handwritten look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a woman with light brown hair in a ponytail, wearing a beige thin-knit long-sleeve crop top and metallic silver-gold shorts. She is kneeling on a large, plush white quilted sofa. The lighting is soft and warm. The background is a dark, textured charcoal wall. The composition features a strong diagonal line from the top-left to the bottom-right created by the sofa's edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin white text in the upper-left quadrant. The first part should be a geometric lowercase sans-serif with wide tracking. Add a thin vertical white line, followed by a thin, casual handwritten script.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text all lowercase?
Is there a vertical line separating the two font styles?
Is the background dark and textured?
Is the sofa white and quilted?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the metallic sheen on the shorts
Exact angle of the sofa diagonal
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
The exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the dark background.
Verify the diagonal composition is maintained.
Check that the metallic texture looks reflective but not blown out.
Confirm the color palette remains muted and warm.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key foreground subject on a diagonal plane with a low-key textured background, topped with minimalist, wide-tracked lowercase typography and a thin vertical separator.
